name: Food protein library v1
source: datasets/Food-Derived Metabolic Wellness Peptide/processed (the Phase 1 protein library: UniProt retrieval, family rules, digestion-eligible mature products)
source_records_filter: only the accessions that have a digestion substrate in digestion_substrates.fasta
note: A substrate is one mature chain of a UniProt protein, the unit the digestion stage cuts. Family and allergen-source flag are the data foundation's, by rule; they are not clinical findings.
terminus_codes: each FASTA header carries NTERM= and CTERM=: the end's state (a removed signal peptide, propeptide, transit peptide or starting methionine; a chain junction; the first or last residue of the UniProt sequence; or unannotated). Meanings: food/a_proteins/fasta.py TERMINUS_MEANING
